name: Asim Mohamed
description: Machine learning researcher working on AI security, content provenance and watermarking, the safety of AI agents, and trustworthy multilingual NLP.
researchInterests: AI security and adversarial robustness of LLMs
Safety of AI agents and agentic automation
Evaluation and red-teaming of language models
bio:
I am a machine learning researcher focusing on AI security, content provenance, and the safety of language models and LLM-based agents. I hold a Master's degree in Machine Intelligence from the African Master's in Machine Intelligence (AMMI) program at AIMS, where my thesis investigated the robustness of LLM watermarking across languages and approaches to improving multilingual watermark detection.

Alongside my research, I work as a Senior AI Engineer, building production LLM agents and retrieval systems, which gives me firsthand insight into the practical challenges of deploying trustworthy AI. I hold a Bachelor's degree with First Class Honours in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, specializing in Electronic Systems Software Engineering, from the University of Khartoum.
